title: Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for August, 27th (AAPL, BAYN, CON, CRZO, HIMX, MCRI, PEGA, TLX, TSLA, WMT)
text:
Posted by Jim Brewer on Aug 27th, 2018 // No Comments
Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Monday, August 27th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $214.00 price target by analysts at Macquarie. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Bayer (FRA:BAYN) was given a €113.00 ($128.41) target price by analysts at Berenberg Bank. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Continental (ETR:CON) was given a €211.00 ($239.77) target price by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Continental (ETR:CON) was given a €225.00 ($255.68) price target by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Carrizo Oil & Gas (NASDAQ:CRZO) was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a sell rating to a hold rating.
Himax Technologies (NASDAQ:HIMX) was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a strong sell rating to a sell rating.
Monarch Casino & Resort (NASDAQ:MCRI) was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a sell rating to a hold rating.
Pegasystems (NASDAQ:PEGA) was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a sell rating to a hold rating.
Talanx (ETR:TLX) was given a €41.00 ($46.59) target price by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) was given a $179.00 price target by analysts at Morningstar, Inc.. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
Walmart (NYSE:WMT) was given a $112.00 price target by analysts at Jefferies Financial Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
